title: No integration test for overlapping (non-duplicate) byte ranges
description: The tests cover exact duplicates (same begin/end) and partial-overlap is tested at the unit level in assembler.rs. However, integration.rs has no test for a genuinely overlapping case where begin/end differ but ranges overlap — e.g. part A covers bytes 1..60 and part B covers bytes 50..100 (overlapping in the middle). This is a realistic Usenet corruption scenario. The existing duplicate_part_rejected test only tests exact duplicates.
